title: New Application Ideas of Dynamics 365 Business Central (2026 JUN)
summary: A monthly roundup of community-submitted improvement ideas for Business Central from June 2026. The ideas are grouped by area, including agents and Copilot, development, financial management, inventory, purchasing, sales, project management and warehousing.
key_points: Ideas span multiple areas: Copilot/agents, data migrations, development, documentation, financial management, inventory, manufacturing, purchasing, sales, and warehouse management
Copilot and agent improvements are requested, including support for more LLMs and better UI instructions
Development requests focus on HTTP methods, API permissions, timeout configurations, and custom file paths
Finance and sales domains have numerous suggestions for approvals, payment reconciliation, pricing, and subscription contracts
User experience improvements requested across lists, workflows, search, and chart interactions

quotes.text: Would any of these ideas improve Business Central? Here is a list of some of them.
quotes.why_it_matters: Sets up the post's purpose as a curated collection of community feature suggestions and improvement ideas
